summary.text: Matt Claman, a Democrat, represents District H in the Alaska Senate; he served in the Alaska House of Representatives from 2015 to 2022 and has been a state senator since 2023.

paragraphs.text: His legislative biography says Claman came to Alaska in 1980, working as a cook in remote mining camps, and later returned after law school to practice as an attorney; he also taught law classes at the University of Alaska Anchorage.
He served on the Anchorage Assembly beginning in 2007, was elected its chair in 2008, and became Acting Mayor of Anchorage in 2009.
